purpose: Compile unmodified production archive and mobile storage source without GTK/Tauri; use original example files as entry points.
manifest:
[package]
name = "viento-studio"
version = "0.2.8"
edition = "2021"
[lib]
name = "viento_studio"
[dependencies]
serde = { version = "=1.0.229", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = { version = "=1.0.151" }
uuid = { version = "=1.26.0", features = ["v4", "serde"] }
sha2 = { version = "=0.10.9" }
unicode-normalization = { version = "=0.1.25" }
zip = { version = "=9.0.5", default-features = false, features = ["deflate"] }
tempfile = { version = "=3.27.0" }
fs2 = { version = "=0.4.3" }
[[bin]]
name = "workspace-archive"
path = "<repo>/src-tauri/examples/workspace-archive.rs"
[[bin]]
name = "mobile-storage"
path = "<repo>/src-tauri/examples/mobile-storage.rs"
[profile.dev]
debug = 0
incremental = false
[profile.test]
debug = 0
incremental = false

rust.ignoredReason: Existing full_project_migration_roundtrip requires full-size source fixture.

limitations: Harness verifies production archive/storage modules directly; full Tauri verification is recorded separately.

placeholders.<repo>: Absolute repository path supplied to prepare-native-harness.py.
placeholders.<harness>: A new temporary directory supplied to prepare-native-harness.py for the fixed source.
placeholders.<baseline-harness>: A separate new temporary directory supplied with --baseline-ref for the old source.
placeholders.<tauri-target>: The new temporary CARGO_TARGET_DIR used for full Tauri verification.
placeholders.<cargo-home>: The local Cargo dependency cache, used only to normalize compiler diagnostic paths.
